responsibility: Declares the small set of Xilinx embedded PowerPC target options consumed by the rs6000 driver specs and subtarget headers. In this file those are mno-clearbss, which affects startup object selection, and mppcperflib, which controls use of the Xilinx performance libraries, making it the option-table companion to xilinx.h rather than a backend code-generation or scheduling file.
same_name_distinction: Unlike xilinx.h, this .opt file does not set driver specs or startup/link defaults; it only declares the Xilinx-specific command-line options accepted by GCC, namely mno-clearbss and mppcperflib, for later use by the subtarget header.
